prompt: The friends that children have are a very important part of their lives. What kinds of influence may children's friends have on them? What can parents do ensure that children's friends are a good influence on them?
essay:
Friendships help children to develop various skills. Individuals who spend time with their friends can be impacted in more than one way. I think  parents should openly communicate and take a genuine interest in their children's daily activities to learn their behaviours.

The first major impact of friendship is the development of social and emotional skills. By interacting and sharing daily experiences, children enhance communication skills effectively, including sharing ideas and learning to cooperate. These aspects ensure positivity and encourage respectful behaviour, which will be greatly helpful to maintain a strong relationship. This can further develop confidence and motivation among peers.

Some of the friendships can be negative as well, as they can lead a friend in the wrong direction, resulting in inappropriate behaviour and negative consequences. At a young age, children are highly influenced by friends and easily impressed by their decisions, which can be very harmful for them. If friends show disrespectful behaviour, children gradually adopt that behaviour in order to stay in that friend circle. Consequently, negative friendships can affect both behaviour and decision-making.

In my view, open communication can help parents to determine what kind of friends their children have. It is very necessary for parents to stay involved and engage with their children's daily activities. This practice will not only help parents to build a close relationship with their children but also encourage sharing  daily conversations with each other. Moreover, parents can arrange opportunities to meet with their children's friends, where they can easily observe their behaviour and identify any negative influence.

In conclusion, friends are a very integral part of our lives , and children can be influenced by both positive and negative friendships.  In order to keep their friendship circle healthy, parents should spend some time with their children to understand who they spend time with and observe their behaviour.
